exposure: US imaging signs (loss of retroplacental clear space, myometrial thinning, placenta lacunar spaces)
MR imaging signs (intraplacental dark bands, focal interruption of myometrial border, abnormal vascularity)
outcome: Placental Adhesion Spectrum (PAS) confirmed by histology
cohort: The study included 51 patients diagnosed with placenta previa.
finding: MR demonstrated higher diagnostic accuracy (91%) than US for detecting PAS, but a combined assessment using both imaging techniques could further improve the probability of detection.
cross-section timing: Performed for diagnosis of PAS in patients with placenta previa, with histology as the reference standard.
